# Pixel Robot Grid Navigator

A single-page offline browser app where a pixel robot moves on a 5×5 grid.

## Features

- Robot starts at the top-left cell facing right.
- **Forward** moves the robot one cell in the current direction; moves that would leave the grid are blocked with feedback.
- **Turn left** / **Turn right** rotate the robot 90°.
- **Reset** returns the robot to its initial position and direction.
- Position and direction readout update after every action.
- Keyboard-accessible buttons with visible focus, hover, and pressed states.

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, network requests, or external assets are required.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure and controls
- `styles.css` – theme, layout, and responsive styles
- `app.js` – game state and interaction logic

## Controls

| Button | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Forward | Move one cell forward (blocked at grid edges) |
| Turn left | Rotate 90° counter-clockwise |
| Turn right | Rotate 90° clockwise |
| Reset | Restore start position and direction |
